newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bombs, rebel attacks in northwest Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Bombs, rebel attacks in northwest Colombia.

text.p: Two bombs damaged shops in Medellin in northwest Colombia on Wednesday, while two leftist rebels died in fighting in the same province, officials said.
One explosion occurred near the regional office of the national newspaper El Tiempo, which was attacked by bombers in December. But police said the intended target was a nearby furniture store.
The small bombs damaged shops but caused no injuries, a Medellin police spokesman said.
Elsewhere in Antioquia province, a force of 70 left-wing guerrillas occupied the town of Argelia but were held back by a small local police detachment.
Two rebels of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) died in the early-morning clash, national police chief Gen. Rosso Jose Serrano said.
The FARC commando melted back into the surrounding mountains when army reinforcements arrived.
